_comment: AI-DLC framework-default model rate table, USD per 1,000,000 tokens. These are PUBLIC Anthropic list prices (platform.claude.com/docs pricing) as of 2026-10 (the Claude API global price; on Amazon Bedrock the same figures are the global cross-Region endpoint price, and regional endpoints cost 10% more), shipped as defaults ONLY. To override, set AIDLC_MODEL_RATES to a rates file of the same shape, or drop a model-rates.json into your install's tools/data/ dir. Keys are version-discrete (one row per model version, never family-collapsed) so a new model or point release is priced on its own row rather than mis-priced onto an old one. input/output price ordinary prompt/completion tokens; cacheWrite5m/cacheWrite1h price cache CREATION at the two ephemeral TTLs (1.25x input for 5m, 2x input for 1h); cacheRead prices a cache HIT (0.1x input on most rows, but 0.05x on opus-5-5 and 0.025x on fable-5-1, so every field is the published price, never derived). A model id must match a key exactly after its [1m] tag, -vN[:M] revision and -YYYYMMDD date are dropped: a point release (opus-5-5) is never priced on its major row (opus-5). An unknown model is recorded with tokens but a null cost - never mis-priced.
